name: Mature public IIC (NIT / large university / central)
needs: Startup tracking; Reporting; IPR; Ecosystem management
why_they_buy: Cannot answer a basic question about their own portfolio while filing it
blockers: Procurement committee above Rs 50K (Phase 2); Existing ERP may already hold the list (H-01)
documentary_basis: NIT Calicut P-A08: 55 vs 17 startups in one PDF - the largest contradiction in the corpus | Phase 3A F-DPIIT-JOIN: IIT Bombay 16/170 and IIT Delhi 8/38 startups lose identity at the join

name: Established private engineering college IIC
institution_types: Engineering College; Private University; Autonomous College
why_they_buy: Deadline pressure with no capacity and no system
blockers: Very thin budget; Coordinator may be the only person (OQ-05)
documentary_basis: Teresa's College P-A02: a 13-item grant narrative typed into a numeric field | Phase 3A F-NODF-GRADIENT: Aditya left 7 'No Data Found' cells, the most in the set

name: Emerging / newly-registered IIC
why_they_buy: MUST submit to keep the IIC alive
blockers: May have no budget at all; May not have anyone accountable (buyer definition fails)
documentary_basis: F-SENTINEL-ZERO: IIT Kanpur records 0 stars while running a mature incubator - registration does not imply activity | IIC counts disagree by 16% across official sources (C-01) - registration status is not verifiable

name: Incubator / AIC / EIC (not a degree institution)
size: 244 seed-funded incubators; AICs need 10,000 sq ft
why_they_buy: Already commercial entities with real budgets and real portfolio churn
blockers: Different buyer - operator, not academic; Competitive (91springboard, NSRCEL already software-literate)
documentary_basis: AIM: AIC/EIC grant-in-aid up to Rs 10 crore - a funded body with procurement capacity Phase 1 institutions lack | SISFS: 217 incubators selected with Rs 916.91 crore approved

name: Research-intensive institute (IISc / R&D organisation)
size: 273 filed the NIRF Research Institutions category in 2025
why_they_buy: IP volume makes the deadline risk concrete and expensive
blockers: Often already has an IP cell or TTO (H-09); Slow, formal procurement
documentary_basis: Phase 3A: IISc had 3 malformed placeholder DPIIT keys (DIPP0000) | IPR: 91,168 national patent filings 2023-24, yet P-A07 finds no deadline calendar in any institution
